ABOUT OUR BUSINESS Quality Japanese cars, for people all over the world Apple International Co., Ltd. is a prominent automobile exporter in Japan. We’re here to serve as ultimate vehicle supplier. We believe in advising our customers on the best deals available on the market, and we strive to help by offering the vehicles that are most suitable to their needs. FORWARD THE FUTURE Nothing symbolizes freedom better than a car. With it, you can go anywhere, meet anyone at your discretion, which could open up a new opportunity, a new chapter in your life. We at Apple, sharing this joy with our customer, have found value in building trust from our customers and society. We, Apple, will continue to challenge presenting a new value to society, open up a new future, and contribute to the development of society. Search SEE MORE STOCK VEHICLES >> SEE MORE AUCTION VEHICLES >> OUR QUALIFIED STAFF Have a specific vehicle in mind that you want to purchase? Don’t have a clue but are looking anyways? Our staff is here to help guide you every step of the way. Meet the team members of Apple below and feel free to contact them. We are more than happy to help you out. SINGAPORE SALES NAOKI NAKAMURA Manager, Overseas division Naoki is the head of our overseas division and in charge of export for our Singapore clients. Naoki has a deep knowledge of automobiles and export business, and has keen eye for undergoing market trend and the regulatory climate. If you have the question, he is likely to be the one who can give the answer. +81-80-3574-7344 MALAYSIA SALES KOTARO "KODY" KITAJIMA Sales assocciate , overseas division Although relatively new to our team, Kody prove to be a quick learner, and has been dedicated to helping our Malaysian customers find the best vehicle at the best price. He loves to interact with people and lives to make people smile.He is also an adept mechanic and a skilled driver. +81-90-4861-7559 WHAT MAKES US SPECIAL What can we do to society? LONG ESTABLISHED We have been in exporting business since 1996. Since then, we have established good relationship with our customers all over the globe; Singapore, Thailand, Hongkong, Malaysia, Sri Lanka, Indonesia, U.A.E. PUBLICLY LISTED We are one of the selected few publicly listed automobile exporter in Japan (Tokyo Stock Exchange Section 2, Code 2788) MEMBERSHIP We are a member of numerous export/import organizations; namely JUMVEA (Japan Used Motor Vehicle Exporters Association), PEKEMA (Malaysian automobile importer organization), SLAEAJ (Sri Lanka Automobile Exporters Association in Japan) APPLE GROUP Our group company, Apple Auto Network Co., Ltd., is one of the largest automobile purchase and sale franchise chain in Japan;There are more than 240 purchase centers all over Japan under franchise, and supplying more than 80,000 cars to Auto Auctions every year.
